tools.name: probe_x402_endpoint
tools.description: Probe an x402 seller endpoint and report what it observes about it. Performs the handshake a paying client would: GET with no X-PAYMENT header, then checks the 402 challenge against 16 rules. Every finding says whether the rule comes from the x402 spec or from an observed facilitator rejection. Repo

tools.name: explain_defect
tools.description: Full explanation of one rule by id — what it checks, why it matters, how to fix it, and where the rule came from. Use when you want the reasoning without re-probing.

tools.name: list_checks
tools.description: The whole rule table. Knowing what was NOT checked is part of knowing what a clean result means.
